sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Maps all existing applications in use across the organization. Identifies redundancies and integration points. Provides insight into application performance and usage. Serves as a baseline for transformation planning. Helps prioritize modernization efforts.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Provides visibility into existing systems for better management. Identifies opportunities for optimization and cost savings. Supports strategic planning and transformation. Enhances system performance and reliability. Facilitates informed decision-making.
